description: This file defines classes, interfaces, and functions for indexing documents, including hashing, deduplication, and managing document storage and updates within a vector store. It is part of a larger indexing system in a machine learning or information retrieval project.

classes.name: _HashedDocument
classes.description: A Document with computed hashes for content and metadata, used for indexing and deduplication.

methods.name: calculateHashes
methods.description: Calculates content and metadata hashes for the document, ensuring reserved keys are not used.

methods.name: toDocument
methods.description: Converts the hashed document back to a standard DocumentInterface.

methods.name: fromDocument
methods.description: Creates a hashed document from a standard DocumentInterface, computing hashes.

methods.name: _hashStringToUUID
methods.description: Hashes a string to a UUID using insecureHash and uuidv5.

methods.name: _hashNestedDictToUUID
methods.description: Serializes a nested dictionary and hashes it to a UUID.
